item.title: Are we slowing down AI progress?
item.description: AI concerns have reached a fever pitch in recent months after several high-profile AI safety incidents this year.

item.title: An alternative model: China’s low-cost AI strategy
item.description: China’s low-cost AI strategy is reshaping the race for AI leadership, driven by efficient models, chip innovation and growing enterprise adoption.

item.title: Weekly market insights: What stock market pessimists may be missing
item.description: Higher debt and rates are grabbing headlines, but earnings strength and market resilience may matter more for long-term investors.

item.title: BOJ raised rates again following June hike
item.description: At its Monetary Policy Meeting held on September 17-18, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) raised its policy rate from 1.00% to 1.25%.

item.title: Uncommon truths: Too soon to buy French bonds
item.description: The spread on French bonds versus Germany has widened to what would normally be considered an attractive level. However, budgetary problems and the risk of a post-election deterioration in French-EU relations, suggests it may be too soon to buy.

item.title: Asian currency outlook: Is the yen set to strengthen?
item.description: Explore why the Japanese yen and other Asian currencies could strengthen as inflation risks, policy shifts, and reduced carry trades weigh on the US dollar.

item.title: FX Pulse quarterly update
item.description: Paul Jackson in Invesco’s GMS Office shares his quarterly outlook on the currency markets. Find out more.

item.title: Higher for longer: What the Fed's latest rate hike means for investors
item.description: The September FOMC meeting marks an important shift in the policy cycle. After more than three years without a rate increase, the Fed has resumed tightening.

item.title: Middle East conflict: The oil shock risk is back
item.description: Tensions in the Middle East have escalated once again, with daily exchanges of strikes between Iran and US assets in the region.

item.title: Weekly market insights: Bull market may have more miles
item.description: Are we nearing the end of the long-running bull market? Some key market and economic signals have suggested the journey may not be over just yet.

item.title: The Big Picture: Leaning into higher yields
item.description: Many central banks are now tightening, and bond yields have risen. However, we believe the global economy remains in expansion mode, which encourages us to continue favouring cyclical assets, if not quite as much as before.
